searchText: Will sharding incentivise centralisation p2p layer? i.e. all validators and all nodes connect with a "leader peer" who has good DOS protection, good latency etc. And eventually disconnect all other connections. This saves everyone's data serving costs by a lot. It might happen even before sharding due to MEV and spam ... but esp curious about once sharding happens so far ethereum is assuming cost of serving data to other nodes is zero, there's no compensation for it. will this assumption break when there's terabytes of data to serve?
